find_duplicate_books: find duplicate audiobook entries by grouping metadata files by author and comparing normalized titles
get_title_similarity_score: compute a Jaccard similarity score between two book title strings using normalized word sets
extract_base_title: extract a normalized base title and structural tags like volume or chapter from a raw title string
group_books_by_author: group audiobook metadata files by author ID to identify books sharing the same author
normalize_title_string: tokenize a title string into lowercase alphanumeric words for comparison or indexing
